{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVQjdzc8AAAABaeV5Lg", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn3IVzhEEvq8", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn3IV", "number": 65, "title": "Latch VDP1 VBlank erase control at the documented raster boundary", "body": "## Problem

Related to #17.

At main `66cb6598cf2050e7ebe6fd54da09271dba6dfc3d`, `Vdp1::vblank_in` immediately starts blank erase when TVMR selects it. `Vdp1::write16` can also start erase immediately after any register write while blanking and VBE is set (`src/vdp1.rs:291–318,404–423`). There is no separate raster-sampled VBE decision.

Sega distinguishes written settings from their effective update timing: VBE switches after the documented post-VBlank-in line-display interval, whereas TVM changes immediately. The current behavior can publish framebuffer writes before that decision and makes erase start depend on CPU register-write completion. This matters to manual erase/change sequences and partially erased buffers presented after a swap. See the [VDP1 system-register timing rules](https://www.infochunk.com/saturn/segahtml_en/hard/vdp1/hon/p04_10.htm).

Existing tests encode immediate start: `vblank_erase_obeys_raster_budget_and_stops_at_field_end_in_both_pixel_depths` expects the first word at VBlank-in plus 201 clocks. That expectation needs specification reconciliation, rather than being treated as the hardware contract.

## Expected outcome

Implement a raster-driven VBE sampling and erase-start sequence, separating written TVMR from the effective erase decision. Preserve completed erase-parameter capture, word publication, physical buffer selection, cancellation and manual framebuffer-change behavior.

Use the following primary contract:

- VDP1 User's Manual, Chapter 4 update-timing list and §4.1 TVMR/VBE: sampling timing, legal write window, unchanged TVM when changing VBE, and valid framebuffer-control combinations. The [later §4.1 text](https://www.infochunk.com/saturn/segahtml_en/hard/vdp1/hon/p04_11.htm) prohibits access between the first and second HBlank-in interrupts after VBlank-in.
- [§4.2 FBCR](https://www.infochunk.com/saturn/segahtml_en/hard/vdp1/hon/p04_12.htm), switching-mode table, erase/change sequence and Table 4.3(b): persistent VBE, manual erase/change and interruption at blank end.
- [§4.4 erase/write](https://www.infochunk.com/saturn/segahtml_en/hard/vdp1/hon/p04_14.htm), Tables 4.4–4.5: geometry and available erase capacity. Cross-check [ST-013-R3](https://antime.kapsi.fi/sega/files/ST-013-R3-061694.pdf), including printed p.35's update-timing list.

Reconcile sampling, erase start and aggregate capacity before implementation. Do not simply subtract an entire raster from the existing budget without primary support. Distinguish specified ordering from an explicitly documented emulator phase convention; do not require measured electrical timing or invent defined results for prohibited programming sequences.

## Context and reproduction

Inspection establishes the issue; no planning-pass test suite was run. Relevant integration points are `Bus::advance_main_clocks` in `src/bus.rs:658–689`, which already distinguishes HBlank-in, VBlank-in/out and line starts, and the retained erase state in `src/vdp1.rs`.

Issue #25 completed EWDR/EWLR/EWRR capture at framebuffer changes. Preserve that work and its mutation/cancellation evidence. Its completion did not establish VBE sampling timing. The current conformance matrix explicitly leaves mid-blank enable and erase/swap timing pending.

Scope is VBE sampling and the resulting blank-erase lifecycle. Full display-erase microsequencing, unrelated PTMR changes, rasterizer changes and VDP2 half-line interlace are outside this increment and remain required under #17.

## Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- [ ] Document an independently derived event table for legal VBE set/clear sequences, persistent enable, sampling, first/last erase publication and VBlank-out cancellation. Cite exact primary sections and reconcile the capacity tables and applicable corrections. Evidence-backed corrections to this AI-authored task may be documented in the source Issue without human approval.
- [ ] Implement the sampled decision through the production raster scheduler. Register writes must not directly launch VBE erase; written-mode readback and effective control must remain distinct. Preserve rotation/HDTV automatic blank-erase behavior, documenting any necessary timing reconciliation.
- [ ] Add independent native boundary vectors for setting and clearing VBE in the permitted post-interrupt window, multiple permitted writes, persistence across fields, and subsequent disable. Assert no premature framebuffer publication and exactly one accepted erase job. Keep prohibited-window behavior explicitly separate from hardware conformance claims.
- [ ] Cover normal 16-bit and high-resolution 8-bit manual sequences, NTSC/PAL and both PLL selections. Verify captured colors/bounds, both physical buffers, incomplete erase at blank end, MODR, retained drawing/status and no fabricated draw-end IRQ. Preserve specification-derived capacity assertions; explain any corrected historical timing expectations.
- [ ] Exercise physically completed SH-2 register transactions around sampling through the real bus adapter. Queued writes must not count as completed. Check SYSRES/cold reset cancellation, passive debugger inspection, and advancement chunks 1/3/17/10000 for identical fixed-horizon results without stale writes.
- [ ] Add an original MIT-licensed SH-2 guest fixture using real SCU raster interrupts, FRT and device MMIO to perform legal enable/disable/manual-swap sequences and compute framebuffer readback/checksum records. Run identical bytes in native Machine and rebuilt production Wasm; verify resulting pixels through the production Canvas path. Include changed erase operands, omitted-enable control and repeated cold boots. Hosts must not supply guest completion or erase results.
- [ ] Demonstrate that the new timing vectors or guest fail against the inherited immediate-start behavior with unchanged independently authored expectations, then pass after the correction. Preserve existing erase-capture, sampling, video-transaction and all three demonstration assertions; correct fixture programming sequences with primary rationale where necessary.
- [ ] Register fixture reproducibility and browser coverage in the existing workflow. Pass `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo build --locked`, `cargo test --locked`, native all-target and Wasm Clippy with `-D warnings`, `sh scripts/check-fixtures.sh`, `sh scripts/build-web.sh`, and complete `npm run test:browser` without required skips.
- [ ] Update architecture, conformance and validation records with specification reconciliation, actual results, negative controls and remaining deviations. Report this as partial #17 progress. Remaining CPU/peripheral, multiprocessor/bus/reset, SCU/DSP, video/audio, CD/media/HLE, SMPC and comprehensive integration requirements remain mandatory. Genuine BIOS and commercial-game compatibility remain unverified.

## Optional validation

Additional legal interlaced erase/change cases using the existing raster conventions; these must not be represented as completion of half-line timing.

## Required post-merge verification

None.
